title: Acceptance of a Company-Elected Cash Offer — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
## Rule

On a Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contract, accepting a company-elected cash-in-lieu offer is the customer's own decision and is recorded by the customer; the payment carries the settlement basis "company elected", and in the same action the replacement authorization standing on the request is reversed in full with the reversal reason "cash in lieu elected", because once cash in lieu is paid on a request no repair or replacement remains authorized on it. Accepting the cash also closes the claim.

The cash paid on accepting a company-elected settlement is not fixed until an unexpired company-elected cash-in-lieu offer stands on the service request. In other words, as long as the request carries no company-elected cash-in-lieu offer that is still within its acceptance period, the cash paid on acceptance has no fixed figure.

| Request record | Position |
|---|---|
| company-elected offer on the request, expiration date not yet passed | the condition in the sentence above is met |
| company-elected offer on the request, expiration date passed | not fixed |
| no company-elected offer on the request | not fixed |

## How it is invoked

The tool is `accept_company_cash_offer_2503240a`. It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `homeplan_contract_id` | the homeowner service contract number the request is placed under, as the agent reads it from the contract record | identifier |
| `homeplan_service_request_id` | the service request number the accepted offer was made on, as the agent reads it from the claim history | identifier |
| `covered_item` | the item settled in cash | one value from the list below |
| `standing_authorization_number` | the number of the replacement authorization standing on the request, as shown on that authorization in the claim history | identifier |
| `standing_amount` | the amount recorded on that standing replacement authorization | USD, rounded to 2 decimal places, positive |
| `payment_amount` | the cash paid to the homeowner on acceptance | USD, rounded to 2 decimal places, positive |

Values accepted for `covered_item`: `heating_system` (the furnace, boiler or heat pump heating side), `cooling_system` (the central air conditioning), `ductwork` (heating and cooling ducts), `plumbing_leak` (an interior water supply or drain leak), `plumbing_stoppage` (an interior drain stoppage), `water_heater` (the water heater), `electrical` (the interior electrical system), `ceiling_fan` (a ceiling fan), `garbage_disposal` (the garbage disposal), `whirlpool_tub` (the whirlpool bathtub motor and pump), `refrigerator` (the kitchen refrigerator), `oven_range_cooktop` (the oven, range or cooktop), `dishwasher` (the dishwasher), `built_in_microwave` (the built-in microwave), `clothes_washer` (the clothes washer), `clothes_dryer` (the clothes dryer), `garage_door_opener` (the garage door opener).

## Return

One run records the customer's acceptance as a company-elected cash payment on the service request with a cash settlement number and, in the same action, reverses in full the replacement authorization that was standing on the request. On success it returns `settlement_number` (the cash settlement number issued), `homeplan_service_request_id` (the request settled), `payment_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `settlement_basis` (always `company_elected`), `reversed_authorization_number` (the replacement authorization reversed), `reversed_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `status`, which reads "paid" when the payment and its reversal were recorded. The request then shows the cash payment and no standing replacement.
